seoTitle: How to Withdraw Money From Stripe to Your Bank
metaDescription: Transfer your Stripe balance to your bank account by verifying your bank details and setting up automatic or manual payouts.
intro: Once your Stripe account starts collecting payments, you'll need to move that balance into your own bank account. This guide walks through how Stripe payouts work and how to withdraw your funds, whether automatically on a schedule or manually whenever you choose.

steps.heading: Review your Stripe dashboard balance
steps.body: Check your available balance in the Stripe dashboard to see how much is ready to be paid out.

steps.heading: Add and verify your bank account
steps.body: Link your bank account details in Stripe and complete any verification steps required before payouts can be sent.

steps.heading: Set up automatic payouts
steps.body: Configure Stripe to automatically transfer your balance to your bank account on a schedule, such as daily or weekly.

steps.heading: Withdraw money manually
steps.body: If you prefer more control, trigger a manual payout from the dashboard whenever you want to move funds out.

faq.question: How long does a Stripe payout take to arrive?
faq.answer: Payout timing varies by country and account history, but it typically takes a few business days for funds to reach your bank.

faq.question: Can I withdraw money before verifying my bank account?
faq.answer: No, Stripe requires a verified bank account before it will send any payouts to you.

faq.question: Is there a fee for withdrawing from Stripe?
faq.answer: Standard payouts are generally free, though Stripe may charge for instant or expedited payout options depending on your account and country.

faq.question: Can I change from automatic to manual payouts?
faq.answer: Yes, you can switch your payout schedule setting between automatic and manual at any time in your Stripe dashboard.
